name: SUN samplers (scaled uniform noise)
plain: Eight core ancestral and SDE solvers re-issued with a uniform noise source scaled by sigma_down, single or multi-resolution. Seed is shifted per sigma. The SDE versions also keep a Brownian noise sampler and choose between.
math: n_i ~ U(−σ↓, σ↓) per channel, seed = seed + int(1000·σ↓). Multi-res sums uniform draws at scales 1,2 and rescales to ±σ↓. Solver update as in core.
